content.rendered: The first AG PAC Meeting of the 2020 school year will be held via Zoom at 3:30 pm. All PAC Meetings will be held at this time while we are in Distance Learning Mode to avoid school schedule conflicts for staff and parents. To receive the link, all persons wanting to attend can email Morgan at president@archerglenpac.org and she will send a link to the meeting.
